role: Waking sun reference for the whole film. Every dream exterior takes the sun of its waking-clock slot from this bank (ruling 5.2 A); the three schemes below are the start and end points of that curve.

schemes.key: high south-west sun; the sister and Alice sit in the elm shade on the flat shelf of the bank, so on faces the key is open shade lit by the sunlit meadow, with small hard sun-flecks through the leaves
schemes.direction_note: sun high in the south-west; short shadows falling north-east; sun-flecks come from above

fill.note: blue-sky open shade plus warm green-gold bounce off the sunlit grass

schemes.atmosphere: faint heat haze over the open meadow; air still
schemes.prompt_fragment_en: Hot early-afternoon midsummer light: a high sun from the south-west pours hard, neutral white sunlight onto the open meadow, while the bank beneath the elms lies in soft, cool open shade broken by small bright sun-flecks through the leaves; faint heat haze over the glaring field, short crisp shadows, a drowsy, sleepy, motionless summer mood.
schemes.reason: The source gives the hot day (ch001-p02) and the sister reading (ch001-p01) but no light. Sun position is taken from environment S01; the shade seat and dappled key are designed so the sleepy heat reads while faces stay out of flat noon glare.

schemes.key: low west-north-west sun raking in under the elm canopy between the trunks
schemes.direction_note: sun a few degrees above the tree line in the west-north-west; long shadows run east-south-east across the bank; falling leaves are rim-lit

fill.note: cooler blue-green evening shade in the grass; soft sky fill

schemes.atmosphere: heat haze gone; clear warm evening air, a light breeze in the tree tops
schemes.prompt_fragment_en: Warm golden-hour evening light: the sun sits just above the tree line in the west-north-west, raking low and golden between the elm trunks as a warm side-backlight, long soft-edged shadows stretching across the bank, a rim of gold on hair and on the few falling leaves, cooler blue-green shade in the grass; gentle, quiet, just-woken calm.
schemes.reason: The source gives falling leaves and 'it's getting late' (ch012-p64, ch012-p66) but no light. Low-sun key, colour and direction are designed from environment S02.

schemes.key: the setting sun itself, in the sister's eyeline
schemes.direction_note: the sister faces west-north-west into the sun, so her face takes a low frontal amber key; wide shots toward the sun become backlit, with glinting reeds and water

fill.note: gold-to-rose sky above the horizon; blue dusk shade on the bank behind her

schemes.atmosphere: clear sunset sky; light breeze moving grass and reeds; the backwater ripples
schemes.prompt_fragment_en: Sunset light: the setting sun rests on the horizon in the west-north-west, a low, deep amber-rose glow falling softly onto a face turned toward it, the sky gold fading to rose, reeds and rippling backwater glinting against the sun, the bank behind sinking into soft blue dusk shade; low contrast, tender, wistful evening mood.
schemes.reason: 'Watching the setting sun' (ch012-p67) makes the sun the stated key and puts it in her eyeline; rippling pool and reeds are explicit (ch012-p70). The sister's reverie (ch012-p68..p70) keeps the real light unchanged.
